prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='NaiveSeasonal', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ARIMA, rf, and NaiveSeasonal all achieve perfect trend correlation (1.0), with ARIMA selected as trend champion. NaiveSeasonal leads in seasonal correlation (0.2342). FT_rf achieves the lowest overall RMSE (19.877). Given unstable rankings (Kendall τ=-0.59) and high model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio=1.44), a robust median or trimmed mean combiner is recommended over weighted stacking to avoid overfitting to fold-specific noise.
